text: Taiz et al. (2019) endorsed Baluska's proposal that the root apex is literally a brain-like information-processing center.
explanation: False. Taiz and colleagues were prominent critics of the plant neurobiology program: they argued the root apex is a growth zone whose sensory integration is not mechanistically special, and that the 'brain' metaphor and neural vocabulary overclaim. It was Baluska, Mancuso, and Trewavas who advanced the root-brain / plant-neurobiology position.
